sonovue_contract.support_authority: First diameter_low_um and last diameter_high_um in the frozen CSV; never a separate hard-coded support
sonovue_contract.explanation: Interpret each original 0.1 um histogram bin as a constant PDF with its empirical probability mass; its CDF is linear. This is not a new parametric fit and uses no smoothing or assumed distribution family.
sonovue_contract.normalization_method: p_i divided by the common math.fsum of input probability; no per-bin reweighting
sonovue_contract.cdf_float64_endpoint_policy: Accumulate normalized probabilities in source order; set last positive cumulative endpoint and any trailing zero endpoints to exactly 1. Zero masses remain exactly zero.
sonovue_contract.inverse_interval_denominator: cdf_high - cdf_low; agrees with normalized probability to recorded float64 roundoff
sonovue_contract.inverse_plateau_convention: Right-side: first positive interval with cdf_high > u for 0<=u<1. Exact plateau probability maps to next positive low edge; inverse(0)=first positive low; inverse(1)=last positive high.
sonovue_contract.sample_interval_convention: Positive [low,high) intervals; exact floating-point high-edge rounding for u<1 is guarded with nextafter(high,low). Shared boundaries have zero continuous mass.
sonovue_contract.gap_policy: Any non-overlapping gap remains zero density; no adjacent bin widths changed
sonovue_contract.population_metadata_format: CSV plus mandatory adjacent .metadata.json bound to CSV SHA256

reproducibility.same_histogram_n_seed: byte-identical arrays and CSV in two independent processes
reproducibility.cross_version_or_cross_architecture_guar: NOT_CLAIMED; record exact environment and output hash per case

sonovue_contract.cdf_table_layout: Two rows per original bin (low/high); repeated shared edges are intentional; all zero bins remain present
sonovue_contract.scientific_scope: Sampler correctness conditional on the frozen manually digitized histogram and uniform-within-bin assumption; no new validation of digitization or transport physics
sonovue_contract.zero_probability_bin_policy: PRESERVED; CDF flat; never sampled as an interval
